scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @wrapt/extension-contracts build && pnpm --filter @wrapt/contracts build && pnpm --parallel --filter @wrapt/server --filter @wrapt/web dev
scripts.build: pnpm build:icons && pnpm --filter @wrapt/extension-contracts build && pnpm --filter @wrapt/contracts build && pnpm --filter @wrapt/server build && pnpm --filter @wrapt/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @wrapt/extension-contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @wrapt/contracts typecheck && pnpm --parallel --filter @wrapt/server --filter @wrapt/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @wrapt/extension-contracts build && pnpm --filter @wrapt/contracts build && pnpm -r test
scripts.quality: pnpm architecture:extensions && pnpm architecture:file-lines && pnpm typecheck && pnpm exec eslint . --max-warnings=0 && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm security:audit
